# C# Naming and XML Documentation

Governing thought: Use feature-centric namespaces, clear PascalCase identifiers, and factual XML docs enforced by StyleCop.

> Drift check: StyleCop/analysis settings live in `Directory.Build.props` and `.editorconfig`; review them before editing.

## Rules (RFC 2119)

- Covered contributors **MUST** read the complete policy files for [naming contracts](../../src/AGENTS.md#naming) and apply their clauses within this instruction's original path, content, and audience scope. Why: Relocation and optional skill selection do not narrow these obligations.

## Scope and Audience

All C# contributors.
